## SalesClientOrderInterface

Main customer-facing order page

File: `app/components/Client/OrderInterface.vue`

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `eventId` | `string` | - | yes |  |
| `products` | `SalesProduct[]` | - | no | Pre-fetched products. When provided, OrderInterface won't call useCollectionQuery. Use this for customer/helper-auth flows where the caller fetches via a helper-token-protected endpoint (e.g., /api/crouton-sales/events/[id]/order-data). When omitted (admin/team-member flows), defaults to fetching via useCollectionQuery. |
| `categories` | `SalesCategory[]` | - | no | Pre-fetched categories. Same semantics as `products`. |
| `clients` | `SalesClient[]` | - | no | Pre-fetched clients for this event's team. |
| `locations` | `SalesLocation[]` | - | no | Pre-fetched locations for this event, used to label per-location remark inputs. |
| `requiresClient` | `boolean` | - | no | Whether this event requires orders to be linked to a client. |
| `productsCollection` | `string` | - | no | Collection name for products query (defaults to 'salesProducts'). Ignored when `products` is provided. |
| `categoriesCollection` | `string` | - | no | Collection name for categories query (defaults to 'salesCategories'). Ignored when `categories` is provided. |
| `currency` | `string` | - | no | Currency for this event ('EUR' \| 'USD', default EUR). Provided to all price displays. |
| `editable` | `boolean` | - | no | Show admin editing affordances (add category / add product, via the crouton create forms). Only enable for team-member sessions — the forms post to team-scoped CRUD endpoints that helper tokens can't reach. |
| `hideEditToggle` | `boolean` | - | no | Hide the inline edit-mode pencil (tabs row). Set by hosts that render the toggle themselves — e.g. the workspace Shell's narrow-mode tab strip — and drive edit mode via the `editMode` model instead. |
| `closable` | `boolean` | - | no | Render a close ✕ at the right of the category-tabs row (after the pencil) and emit `close` — for a full-bleed kassa with no header/strip of its own (the launcher's "Open kassa" modal). |
| `editMode` | `boolean` | `false` | no |  |

| Event | Payload |
| --- | --- |
| `update:editMode` | `[value: boolean]` |
| `close` | `[]` |
